scores.label: A
scores.note: options 6 amass, 7 accumulate, 8 procure and 9 obtain mean the athletes acquire or collect money themselves, the wrong sense for generating revenue for schools; generate is strong; produce/earn/make/create/secure are usable

scores.label: B
scores.note: options 2 collect and 4 gather imply the athletes physically gather the money; 8 fetch is an odd price sense; 10 procure means obtain, wrong sense; option 9 failed as a duplicate

scores.label: C
scores.note: options 2 amass and 5 accumulate are the wrong sense (gathering for oneself); 6 derive is ungrammatical without 'from'; 7 reap and 9 harvest imply the athletes gain the money; 8 yield is odd with a person as subject; option 10 failed as a duplicate
